title: BlessBoard V2.12 sanity defect regression matrix
productStatusPolicy: Do not mark unresolved product defects as fixed. BB-05 has a local uncommitted repair only.

issues.title: Homepage section editing
issues.originalDefect: Administrators cannot reliably create/edit homepage sections with correct editor controls for supported section types.
reproductionSteps: Sign in as church website editor/admin
Open website home editor / add-section flow
Add or edit plain_text, image, and image_text sections
Observe editor resolution, validation, and permission enforcement
issues.expectedBehavior: Supported section types resolve to the correct editor; text/image schemas validate; unsupported types fail safely; unauthorized actors are denied.
routes: GET /hq/website and branch website editor chrome
issues.crossTenant: Section mutations must remain scoped to the actor church/branch; foreign church IDs denied.
issues.dataSetupTeardown: Synthetic church + website draft fixtures; disposable CI DB only.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized integration + browser journey showing add/edit/persist/publish of text_/cta_/image_/story_ sections, including CTA buttonText and buttonUrl. DB-independent editor contract already passes. Database journeys are not passed.

issues.title: Announcement image upload and public visibility
issues.originalDefect: Announcement attachment upload/publish does not reliably keep media tenant-owned or publicly visible when published.
reproductionSteps: Attach media asset and publish with audience_public
Visit public announcement URL as anonymous visitor
issues.expectedBehavior: Upload validation rejects unsupported MIME; attachments associate to church; drafts stay private; published+public audience exposes images.
issues.crossTenant: Attachment and announcement rows must match churchId; foreign asset IDs rejected.
issues.dataSetupTeardown: Synthetic announcement + media asset; no production media.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized upload + publish + anonymous public image visibility. DB-independent contracts already pass.

issues.title: New event creation
issues.originalDefect: New event creation fails or does not persist with correct branch/tenant scoping.
reproductionSteps: Open GET /branch/events/new or content-admin events form
Submit required fields via POST /branch/events or POST /hq/content/events
issues.expectedBehavior: GET renders create form; POST validates required fields; CSRF enforced; branch/org scoped; unauthorized denied.
issues.crossTenant: Events created only for authenticated branch organization_id/branch_id.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized create+publish persistence. DB-independent form, CSRF, date, and scope contracts already pass.

issues.title: New sermon creation
issues.originalDefect: New sermon creation fails or does not publish with correct visibility.
reproductionSteps: POST /branch/sermons with title and optional media
issues.expectedBehavior: Form contracts intact; title required; CSRF on POST; branch scoping; publication status honored.
issues.crossTenant: Sermon rows bound to organization_id and branch_id of actor.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized create/publish and public visibility. DB-independent Add sermon, metadata, image, and scope contracts already pass.

issues.title: HQ member registration CSRF failure
issues.originalDefect: POST /hq/members/new fails with Unavailable: Invalid or missing CSRF token due to double CSRF issuance.
issues.expectedBehavior: Single CSRF issuance; form token matches cookie; missing/invalid/cross-session rejected; duplicates validated.
issues.crossTenant: Member creation scoped to HQ church; foreign church denied.
issues.dataSetupTeardown: DB-independent CSRF contracts always; duplicate/persistence under authorized DB stages only.
issues.evidenceToClose: Committed BB-05 fix + hosted retest + authorized integration persistence

issues.title: Member portal activation
issues.originalDefect: Staff-created members remain not_activated; portal activation/login journey incomplete or unverified.
reproductionSteps: Create member via HQ Add Member
Accept invitation, set credentials, log in
issues.expectedBehavior: Authorized invitation; verified identity before linking; expiry/replay rejected; member-church association correct; unauthorized activation denied.
validInputs: pending invitation token for bound recipient
issues.crossTenant: Activation cannot link member to foreign church/org.
issues.ciJob: v13-bb-qa-regression stage-a documents NOT_IMPLEMENTED gaps; no default failing blocker job for missing product wiring
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized invitation acceptance, password setup, and member login. DB-independent invitation and identity contracts already pass.

issues.title: Public directory and church-specific contact/join workflow
issues.originalDefect: Directory/contact/join flows lose selected church identity or route into church-owner registration.
reproductionSteps: Open /directory and select a church card
Confirm enquiry lands on that tenant; join does not open /register-church owner flow
issues.expectedBehavior: Cards target selected church; contact retains church identity; messages routed to correct tenant; join ≠ owner registration; cross-tenant enquiry denied.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized two-church enquiry persistence and inbox isolation. Directory and identity contracts already pass.

issues.title: Invited staff password setup and login
issues.originalDefect: Staff invitation acceptance, password setup, and post-accept role authorization incompletely verified.
issues.expectedBehavior: Invitation create/validate; password setup; expiry/replay rejected; user/tenant association correct; login + role authz after accept.
issues.crossTenant: Invitation acceptance limited to invitation organization/church.
issues.evidenceToClose: Authorized first login with the new password, including role, tenant, session persistence, and revocation. Source contracts do not close this.
